answer: A newcomer begins a public voyage of small real jobs across unrelated trades, each leg sealed at a beacon checkpoint by a stranger who needed the work. Every completed leg earns one opal token, unique and non-transferable, and only a full set from many different beacons unlocks higher privileges. A farm cannot fake dozens of voyages: each leg costs stranger-checked effort, identical routes across accounts expose the cluster at once, and any leg skipped or faked sends that account back to the first beacon alone. Standing grows only with the voyage itself, never with headcount.
